cloud_model.description: Gemini model used by Firebase AI Logic when a request runs in the cloud.

on_device_max_chars.description: Notes longer than this go straight to the cloud model (Gemini Nano has a ~9k token window).

privacy_shield_enabled.description: Redact personal data on-device before any text is sent to the cloud model.

shield_max_chunks.description: Max ~8k-char chunks scanned by on-device entity detection (regex covers the rest).

default_routing.description: Default routing for new users: auto | local | cloud.

announcement.description: Optional banner text shown at the top of the app.
